name: Angel 1
overview: The sample verses from Genesis 19 depict angels as divine messengers who interact closely with humans, exemplified by their visit to Lot in Sodom. These angels demonstrate both hospitality and protection, accepting Lot's invitation and ultimately safeguarding him from the wicked men surrounding the city. This passage highlights angels' role in executing God's judgment on the wicked while ministering to the righteous, reflecting their dual function as both protectors and agents of divine justice.
